comment: Mono only: process() reads the audio input with getVoltageSum() and never calls setChannels. No range is recorded for the Time input because it depends on a knob: the maker's port description reads "1V/octave when Time CV is 100%", and Delay.cpp:123 multiplies the jack by the Time CV knob before adding it to the pitch. The Audio input takes a polyphonic cable and sums every channel to one (Delay.cpp:115); the delay line itself is mono, which is why the maker does not tag the module Polyphonic.
